keel_session.original_prompt: a tool to tidy up my downloads folder

io_contract.value: Takes a folder path; moves files into subfolders by type and prints a summary of what moved.

runtime.value: Run by hand from a terminal when the folder gets messy.

scale.value: However many files happen to be in a downloads folder — usually not many, occasionally a lot.

constraints.value: A single-file Python script, standard library only, works offline.

non_goals.value: No GUI, no config file, no undo history, no scheduling.

done.value: Running it on a messy folder leaves it sorted into type subfolders and prints what it did.

data_model.value: One entry per file: original path, detected type, destination path.

interfaces.value: tidy <folder> [--dry-run] — sort the folder, or just print the plan.

error_handling.value: An unreadable file is skipped and listed; a missing folder exits non-zero with a message.

auth_model.value: No sign-in and no user accounts — everyone using it sees the same data.

seed_data.value: Ships empty; the first user creates all the data.
